components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific (MR/MRS/MS/DR) used to compose the salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. On create/update it is accepted as a flat value for backward compatibility; when structured lines are supplied it is the composed, normalized address returned in responses.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: First line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: Optional second line of the structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^(\D*\d){10}\D*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present, an 'ageBand' is derived from it.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: Stable shared identifier for owners of the same household (same last name and address), assigned when 'sharesHousehold' is set.
          type: string
          example: '2f1b8c0e-0d3a-3b6e-9f4a-1c2d3e4f5a6b'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode."
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: "The owner's version-2 identity group: the member id, identity key and household id, each rederived under the version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag."
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member id
          description: "The owner's version-2 unified member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. The visible REGION is the plain region; the 'V2' tag is mixed only into the hashed portion."
          type: string
          example: 'NSW26A1B2C3D40'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: "The owner's version-2 duplicate-detection key: the SHA-256 hex of the 'V2' tag, normalizedTelephone, email and soundex(lastName)."
          type: string
          example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: "The owner's version-2 household identifier derived from the 'V2' tag, normalized last name and postcode."
          type: string
          example: '2f1b8c0e0d3a'
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - memberId
        - identityKey
        - householdId
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner id, e.g. '/api/owners/1'."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's title and last name, e.g. 'DR who'; just the last name when no title is given."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's initials, upper-cased and dot-separated, e.g. 'G.F.'.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: "The owner's unified member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region, the 2-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, the 8 upper-hex first bytes of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and a single Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>', e.g. 'NSW26A1B2C3D40'."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW26A1B2C3D40'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The owner's fiscal year formatted 'FY<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, e.g. 'FY26'."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "The owner's membership points: 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's region derived from their city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's '<TIER>_<AREA>' segment: TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more else 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' for a known region (NSW/VIC/QLD) else 'REGIONAL'."
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The owner's IANA timezone derived from their region (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); absent for any other region."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+); absent when birthDate is not supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: Number of existing owners sharing the same first and last name (case-insensitively) when this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created today, signalling a bulk-signup surge; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the 50-owner capacity limit); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The owner's duplicate-detection key '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' (email and householdId empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "True when this owner shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode but has a different telephone (a soft, non-hard duplicate); otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes, e.g. '+61 412 345 678'."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this one possibly duplicates, when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: "True when any risk signal holds: the owner is a possible duplicate, the email domain is disposable-adjacent (a subdomain of a disposable domain), or the city is over its soft capacity (40 or more owners); otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE; a newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object

Released version 2 of the owner identity while keeping structural impact low — each edited function stays simple and I avoided touching the large REST controller entirely.

**Version-2 identifiers** (one-line hash-input change each; every identifier now differs from v1 and no v1 value can recur, since the uppercase `"V2"` tag is unreachable by the lowercased/E.164-normalized v1 inputs):

- `Households.id` — SHA-256 input prefixed with `V2`.
- `IdentityKeys.of` — SHA-256 input prefixed with `V2`.

**Response shape** (`openapi.yml` + `OwnerMapper`):
- Added a new `OwnerIdentity` schema and nested `memberId`/`identityKey`/`householdId` under a top-level `identity` object; removed the three from the top level.
- Added top-level integer `apiVersion: 2`.
- The mapper maps into `identity.*`, adds `apiVersion`, and ignores top-level `householdId`.

**Audit event** (contained entirely in `OwnerCreatedEvent` — the controller call site is unchanged):
- Added `schemaVersion: 2` and an `ownerSegment` recomputed from the v2 identity's region + membership level, both emitted in `toJson()`.

**Compile fix:** `OwnerWelcomeNotificationAdvice` read the now-moved `OwnerDto.getMemberId()`; repointed it to `getIdentity().getMemberId()` with a null guard.

Request fields are unchanged.
